name: durability-fifo-queue-template
description: Partitioned FIFO queue with multiple targets, autoscaling, and an admin dashboard on Durable Objects

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Protects the dashboard and the admin API. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

PRODUCER_TOKEN.description: Sent by producers as a bearer token when posting messages. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

TOPOLOGY.description: Holds each queue's published partition list, read by the Worker on every send.

STORAGE.description: Holds dead letters and the batches written by archive targets.
